Cello will remain CFO through December 31, 2026, and serve as a full-time advisor through March 1, 2027, to support the transition.
Moreover, the company has started a search for his successor with an executive search firm.

It also reaffirmed its third-quarter and full-year 2026 guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted diluted EPS, saying the CFO transition is not expected to affect its operations, strategy, or capital allocation plans.

title: TransUnion CFO Todd Cello to step down; 2026 guidance reaffirmed
